# Department of Energy

> The official website of the U.S. Department of Energy, providing comprehensive information on nuclear security, energy policy, scientific research, and critical infrastructure protection.

Energy.gov serves as the primary information hub for DOE's mission to advance American energy dominance, manage nuclear weapons security, and conduct cutting-edge scientific research through 17 national laboratories. The site covers policy, security initiatives, energy data, and STEM education programs.

## Key Topics

- Nuclear Security
- Energy Security
- National Nuclear Security Administration (NNSA)
- Critical Infrastructure
- Nonproliferation
- National Laboratories
- Energy Policy
- Cybersecurity
- Strategic Petroleum Reserve
- Artificial Intelligence
- Manhattan Project
- Emergency Response
- Environmental Management
- Nuclear Weapons Stockpile
- Genesis Mission

## Security & Nuclear Affairs

- [National Nuclear Security Administration](https://www.energy.gov/nnsa/national-nuclear-security-administration): NNSA homepage for nuclear weapons stockpile and nonproliferation
- [Nuclear Security](https://www.energy.gov/topics/nuclear-security): NNSA nuclear security, weapons stockpile, and nonproliferation initiatives
- [Energy Security](https://www.energy.gov/topics/energy-security): Energy infrastructure security, Strategic Petroleum Reserve, and grid resilience
- [Cybersecurity](https://www.energy.gov/topics/cybersecurity): DOE cybersecurity strategy for energy sector critical infrastructure protection

## Organization & Leadership

- [Department of Energy Homepage](https://www.energy.gov): DOE homepage covering energy policy, Genesis Mission, and American energy dominance
- [Our Leadership & Offices](https://www.energy.gov/our-leadership-offices): DOE leadership team, organizational structure, and office directory
- [U.S. Department of Energy National Laboratories](https://www.energy.gov/us-department-energy-national-laboratories): Directory of 17 DOE national laboratories for scientific research and innovation
- [Power Marketing Administrations](https://www.energy.gov/power-marketing-administrations): Four PMAs managing federal hydroelectric power distribution and sales

## Energy Data & Information

- [U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA)](https://www.energy.gov/us-energy-information-administration-eia): EIA energy data, forecasts, and renewable/petroleum information hub
- [Research, Technology, and Economic Security](https://www.energy.gov/topics/research-technology-and-economic-security): DOE research security, supply chain protection, and foreign talent screening
- [Earth Systems Modeling](https://www.energy.gov/topics/earth-systems-modeling): DOE climate modeling research using E3SM and supercomputing technologies

## Environmental Management & Operations

- [Environmental and Legacy Management](https://www.energy.gov/topics/environmental-and-legacy-management): Environmental cleanup and legacy waste management at DOE sites
- [Emergency Response Hub](https://www.energy.gov/ceser/emergency-response-hub-0): DOE emergency response resources and disaster management information

## News & Communications

- [Newsroom](https://www.energy.gov/newsroom): DOE press releases, blogs, and announcements on energy funding and policy
- [Digital Engagement and Media](https://www.energy.gov/digital-engagement-and-media): DOE social media channels and digital engagement resources

## History & Education

- [History](https://www.energy.gov/lm/history): DOE history from Manhattan Project through Cold War and nuclear energy evolution
- [Department of Energy Nobel Laureates](https://www.energy.gov/science/department-energy-nobel-laureates): List of 118 DOE-affiliated Nobel Prize winners and scientific achievements
- [National Science Bowl](https://www.energy.gov/topics/national-science-bowl): DOE student science competition for STEM education and outreach
